record.title: Gabon COVID land-passenger restrictions beginning with northern closure in March 2020
record.scope: Initial northern land frontier restrictions, extended to national land boundaries; permitted movement categories changed over time.
record.crossings: Kyé-Ossi/Meyo-Kyé specifically documented; national extension covers other land crossings without separate gate observations.
record.direction: Entry and exit restrictions, with specified conditional exceptions; no uniform total two-way seal inferred.
record.movement: Ordinary non-exempt land passengers; later explicit conditional return/institutional travel and essential-goods exceptions.
record.exceptions: February 1, 2021 notice permits specified Gabonese/regional return travel and international/subregional personnel under conditions, essential food/fuel/gas/medical supplies, and authorised entry/exit with tests and special permits. Some local pedestrian passage was observed in the initial northern phase.
record.imposing_authority: Gabon Ministry of Interior and national government.
record.enforcement: Ministerial closure directives; northern bridge reportage describes enforced vehicle/traveller restrictions and limited local passage.
record.consequences: Northern travellers and transporters reported disruption; national economic losses not inferred.
record.relationship: Promotes SCL01 with stronger onset, exception and continuation evidence, while leaving the reopening question unresolved. Distinct from SC04 August 2023 coup closure and R5-AES-006 election order.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no inference of status at the 2026-10-21 cutoff.
record.official_rationale: Prevent COVID-19 importation and spread; later renewed precautions associated with rising infections.
record.context: Northern restrictions followed cases in Cameroon. National directive was reported by March 14 and confirmed March 20; June air reopening expressly left land borders closed.
record.uncertainty: Staged onset: March 6 northern restriction and national expansion by March 14, confirmed March 20. February 2021 article’s April onset is inconsistent and rejected. Later general COVID-lifting announcements/decrees do not by themselves establish land-specific operational reopening. No uniform continuous interval reconstructed.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. No duration: staged onset, changing exceptions and unknown land-specific endpoint. February 1, 2021 is a dated restriction notice, not extension to cutoff.
